title: Existential prefixes and satisfiability
statement: Let $m$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. If the variable count of $m$ is at most $n$, then the quantified formula with $n$ successive existential quantifiers, starting from the all-false assignment at variable index $0$, is true if and only if $m$ is satisfiable.
